coverage: Engine Preview builds with the Windows endpoint-volume broker integration
default launcher remains user-space and source-only
normal preview still performs Hello/Ack, volume, status, physical catalog and IR checks
normal mode does not request or write Windows endpoint volume
explicit opt-in binds the default render endpoint broker
initial dB/mute/generation state is accepted by Main Group Master
status-only path sends no volume command
C# control model remains compatible with the new route status
volume round-trip, SceneApply and IR graph attachment regression path
self-contained Desktop Compatibility Preview launches without Windows App Runtime

limitations: The opt-in link currently targets the default physical render endpoint through user-space IAudioEndpointVolume; it is not a Hibiki virtual WaveRT endpoint.
This does not provide transparent interception for vendor ASIO, WASAPI Exclusive or RAW paths, and it does not prove physical DSP playback.
The write-through path is intentionally not exercised by smoke to avoid changing the user's volume; target-device hotplug, Audio Service restart and signed-driver tests remain pending.
The local machine is Windows 22631/Visual Studio 17 with SDK 26100, below the locked Windows 11 24H2/VS 2026/WDK target.
All build outputs remain under ignored .local paths and are not GitHub artifacts.
